```ts
describe("import from other platforms 3b", () => {

  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.unique ?? false, i.config.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(i.config.where).sql : null])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .foreignKeys.map((k) => [k.reference().columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, k.onDelete])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const TABLES = ["import_jobs", "import_picks", "import_keys"];

  test("the three tables are public, with row level security and one allow-all policy for the API role", () => {
    for (const name of TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBeUndefined();
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("the two enums: the three sources, and the twelve states in the order of section 4.1", () => {

    expect(schema.importStatus.enumName).toBe("import_status");
    expect(schema.importStatus.enumValues).toEqual(["uploading", "scanning", "ready", "preparing", "publishing", "done", "stopped", "undoing", "undone", "failed", "cancelled", "expired"]);
  });

  test("import_jobs: every column of 6.1 in its order, the counts and cursors at zero, the state uploading by default", () => {
    expect(shape("import_jobs")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["owner_id", "uuid", true],
      ["source", "import_source", true],
      ["status", "import_status", true],
      ["declared_bytes", "bigint", true],
      ["received_bytes", "bigint", true],

      ["confirmed_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["ended_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],

      ["staff_ended_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["staff_rule_id", "text", false],

      ["images_kept", "integer", true],
      ["images_left_out", "integer", true],
      ["posts_removed", "integer", true],
    ]);
    // The API makes the id (it names the import's folders): no default. The insert trigger forces the rest.
    expect(column("import_jobs", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(column("import_jobs", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(false);
    expect(column("import_jobs", "status")?.default).toBe("uploading");
    for (const name of ["received_bytes", "post_cursor", "image_cursor", "posts_published", "images_kept", "images_left_out", "posts_removed"]) {
      expect(column("import_jobs", name)?.default, name).toBe(0);
    }
    // No on delete clause: no profile row is ever deleted.
    expect(foreignKeys("import_jobs")).toEqual([["owner_id", "profiles", "no action"]]);

  test("import_jobs: its CHECKs, each list and number of 6.1 and 9.3 written out", () => {
    expect(checks("import_jobs")).toEqual([
      "import_jobs_choice",
      "import_jobs_counts",
      "import_jobs_declared_bytes",
      "import_jobs_failed",
      "import_jobs_failure",
```

```sql
-- Everything below is written by hand (3b design, sections 6.1, 6.4 and 6.7; Task 2). As in 0016 to 0042: every function

-- import_column under SQLSTATE 42501. "For every role but the migrator" means current_user <> 'korbat_migrate'. Every
-- trigger of this file skips the migrator, the two delete rules included (6.1 does not say whether they do), so the tests
-- and the command line can clean up as the migrator, as they clean up every other table. The two enums are new in this
-- file: each function compares them as text (section 6), and the unique index above names its five labels as labels,
-- since an index predicate takes no cast of an enum to text (enum_out is not immutable).

-- The CHECKs above hold the contracts' numbers and lists (packages/contracts/src/imports.ts), and
-- apps/api/test/integration/import-schema.test.ts holds each migrated one equal to its constant:

--   import_jobs_choice           IMPORT_RULES.choiceMaxBytes, the same
--   import_jobs_seed             IMPORT_RULES.seedBytes

-- 1. The grants (6.4). 0001's default privileges gave the API role every right on a new public table; each table loses
-- them all, then gets what 6.4 lists. import_jobs: read, insert, delete (under import_jobs_delete), and UPDATE of every
-- column but the five that never change (id, owner_id, source, declared_bytes, created_at), all under import_jobs_guard.
-- import_picks: read, insert, delete, and the two columns of a choice, under import_picks_guard. import_keys: read, insert
-- and delete (under import_keys_delete); never an update. korbat_auth and korbat_notify get nothing.

-- 2. import_jobs_insert, plain, BEFORE INSERT, for every role but the migrator (6.1): an import is born uploading, at
-- clock_timestamp(), with no byte, count or cursor, and keeps nothing of the insert but its id, its owner, its source and
-- its declared size. An owner whose profile is deleted, or that has no profile, is not_found: the purge marks the profile
-- deleted before it deletes anything (4.7), so no import starts for an account on its way out. Whether the account is
-- live and not suspended is the creating statement's to judge, under 3e's predicate (8.5), not this trigger's.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_insert"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles a WHERE a.id = NEW.owner_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found';
  END IF;
  NEW.status := 'uploading';
  NEW.created_at := clock_timestamp();
  NEW.received_bytes := 0;
  NEW.uploaded_at := NULL;
  NEW.scanned_at := NULL;
  NEW.confirmed_at := NULL;
  NEW.ended_at := NULL;
  NEW.failure := NULL;
  NEW.stop_reason := NULL;
  NEW.staff_ended_at := NULL;
  NEW.staff_rule_id := NULL;
  NEW.refused_at_original := NULL;
  NEW.refused_words := NULL;
  NEW.scan := NULL;
  NEW.choice := NULL;
  NEW.stated_at := NULL;
  NEW.seed := NULL;
  NEW.post_cursor := 0;
  NEW.image_cursor := 0;
  NEW.posts_published := 0;
  NEW.images_kept := 0;
  NEW.images_left_out := 0;
  NEW.posts_removed := 0;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_insert"() FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TRIGGER "import_jobs_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "public"."import_jobs" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_insert"();--> statement-breakpoint

-- 3. import_jobs_guard, plain, BEFORE UPDATE, for every role but the migrator (6.1). Every refusal is import_column.
--   - id, owner_id, source, declared_bytes and created_at never change.
--   - The state moves only along the eighteen arrows of 4.1, and into undoing from stopped only when posts_published is
--     above 0. An update that keeps the state is no move.
--   - ended_at changes only in a move into done, stopped, undone, failed, cancelled or expired, and is set after it. Every
--     way into undone passed through done or stopped, which set it: the move into undone may set it again (the undo's
--     end), every other move sets it once.
--   - uploaded_at changes only in the move into scanning, which sets it with received_bytes equal to declared_bytes.
--   - scanned_at changes only in the move out of scanning, which sets it.
--   - scan changes only in the move into ready, which sets it, and in the move out of ready (whichever it is), which
--     leaves it without its month table, its samples, its pages and its count of posts skipped as not_public, keeping
--     fromRef and the counts the result screen shows (decision 25).
--   - choice, stated_at, confirmed_at and the seed change only in the move out of ready into preparing or publishing (the
--     confirmation), which sets all four; the seed may later only become null, and the moves into done and stopped leave
--     it null (the import has ended, 6.6).
--   - failure changes only in the move into failed; stop_reason only in the move into stopped (the CHECKs say when each
--     is set).
--   - staff_ended_at and staff_rule_id are set once, in a move into stopped or undoing (8.7); a move into stopped sets
--     them exactly when its reason is by_staff.
--   - refused_at_original and refused_words are set once, in the move into stopped whose reason is refused_image (8.2).
--   - received_bytes, both cursors and the four counts never go down.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_guard"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  was text;
  goes text;
  moved boolean;
  confirming boolean;
BEGIN
  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  was := OLD.status::text;
  goes := NEW.status::text;
  moved := goes <> was;
  confirming := moved AND was = 'ready' AND goes IN ('preparing', 'publishing');
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_id OR NEW.source::text IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source::text
     OR NEW.declared_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.declared_bytes OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF moved AND (was, goes) NOT IN (('uploading', 'scanning'), ('uploading', 'failed'), ('uploading', 'cancelled'), ('uploading', 'expired'),
                                   ('scanning', 'ready'), ('scanning', 'failed'), ('scanning', 'cancelled'),
                                   ('ready', 'preparing'), ('ready', 'publishing'), ('ready', 'cancelled'), ('ready', 'expired'),
                                   ('preparing', 'publishing'), ('preparing', 'stopped'),
                                   ('publishing', 'done'), ('publishing', 'stopped'),
                                   ('done', 'undoing'), ('stopped', 'undoing'), ('undoing', 'undone')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF moved AND was = 'stopped' AND goes = 'undoing' AND NEW.posts_published <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.ended_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ended_at AND NOT (moved AND goes IN ('done', 'stopped', 'undone', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')))
     OR (moved AND goes IN ('done', 'stopped', 'undone', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired') AND NEW.ended_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.uploaded_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.uploaded_at AND NOT (moved AND goes = 'scanning'))
     OR (moved AND goes = 'scanning' AND (NEW.uploaded_at IS NULL OR NEW.received_bytes <> NEW.declared_bytes)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.scanned_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scanned_at AND NOT (moved AND was = 'scanning'))
     OR (moved AND was = 'scanning' AND NEW.scanned_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.scan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scan AND NOT (moved AND (goes = 'ready' OR was = 'ready')))
     OR (moved AND goes = 'ready' AND NEW.scan IS NULL)
     OR (moved AND was = 'ready' AND (NEW.scan -> 'months' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR NEW.scan -> 'samples' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
                                      OR NEW.scan -> 'pages' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR NEW.scan #> '{skipped,not_public}' IS NOT NULL)) THEN

LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$

-- while its import is ready. The job's row is taken FOR SHARE and read again in a statement of its own, so a pick that
-- meets a confirmation in flight waits for it and then sees the import gone from ready. A pick may be deleted in any
-- state: import-drive deletes them when the import ends, and the job row's cascade does in any case.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."import_picks_guard"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$

  job_status text;
BEGIN

    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT j.status::text INTO job_status FROM public.import_jobs j WHERE j.id = NEW.import_job_id;

    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';

-- once its profile is deleted, so only the purge erases it. It is never updated: the API role holds no UPDATE on it.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."import_keys_delete"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$

  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
```

```sql
-- 2. posts_import_guard, plain, BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF the five import columns, for every role but the migrator
-- (6.2). Only a statement that names one of the five meets it, so a counter's update (every like, repost and reply) never
-- runs it; an insert always does.
--   - An insert with import_job_id set must name a job whose owner is the post's author, whose state is publishing and
--     whose source is the post's import_source; the post's original_created_at lies between IMPORT_RULES.earliestDate at
--     UTC midnight and IMPORT_RULES.futureDays after the job's created_at; it quotes nothing; and a reply answers a post of
--     the same job. The job's row is taken FOR SHARE and read again in a statement of its own (the publisher holds it FOR
--     UPDATE already, 6.5, so this costs it nothing). A parent written by the same multi-row insert is seen when its row
--     comes first: a row-level BEFORE trigger's queries see the rows its statement wrote before. A native insert names
--     none of the five; posts_import_columns refuses one that names some.
--   - An update may change the five only to null, all at once, and only on a row whose state the statement makes, or
--     leaves, deleted_by_author (the author's deletion, the undo, the purge): no update ever sets them.
-- By name it runs after posts_guard_insert on an insert, and after posts_guard_update on an update.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."posts_import_guard"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  job public.import_jobs;
BEGIN
  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.import_job_id IS NULL THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.import_jobs j WHERE j.id = NEW.import_job_id FOR SHARE;
    SELECT j.* INTO job FROM public.import_jobs j WHERE j.id = NEW.import_job_id;

       OR job.source::text IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.import_source::text
       OR NEW.original_created_at < timestamptz '2006-03-21 00:00:00+00'
       OR NEW.original_created_at > job.created_at + make_interval(days => 1)
       OR NEW.quote_of_id IS NOT NULL

    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.import_job_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.import_job_id AND NEW.import_source::text IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.import_source::text
     AND NEW.original_created_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.original_created_at AND NEW.import_shortened IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.import_shortened
     AND NEW.import_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.import_key THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.import_job_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.import_source IS NOT NULL OR NEW.original_created_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.import_shortened IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.import_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.state::text <> 'deleted_by_author' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 5. decision_actions_check, replaced (0032). Everything 0016, 0021, 0025, 0028 and 0032 say of it stands, stated again
-- in full, with one change in the basis flood (3b design, section 8.5): the count of the subject's posts in the last
-- flood_minutes, the floor under an admin's finding of a spam flood, counts only posts with import_job_id null. An import
-- is published at once by design (decision 9) and reaches no feed, so it is no flood. The text is 0032's, from its line
-- 27 to its line 484, byte for byte, but for that one clause (import-schema.test.ts holds it so). The API's own count,
-- standing.flood in apps/api/src/moderation/standing-repo.ts, gains the same clause in Task 6. CREATE OR REPLACE keeps
-- the function's owner and its grants.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decision_actions_check"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  c public.cases;
  subject uuid;
  is_measure boolean;
  lifted public.action_kind[];
  target uuid;
  target_decision public.decisions;
  decider_role text;
  post_state public.post_state;
  post_level public.moderation_level;
  image_state public.media_moderation_state;
  profile public.profiles;
  rules record;
  max_days integer;
  basis_decision uuid;
  earlier_decision uuid;
  ladder_count integer;
  ladder_decisions uuid[];
  newest_strike_at timestamptz;
  newest_rule text;
  last_ladder_at timestamptz;
  rungs_used integer;
  ladder_holds boolean := false;
  reports_sent integer;
  reports_marked integer;
  warning_decision uuid;
  warning_told timestamptz;
  -- 3f: the order a disable_by_order gives effect to, and whether a notice about the case's post is held.
  ord public.legal_orders;
  held boolean;
BEGIN
  -- 1.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = NEW.decision_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR d.xact IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR d.decided_at IS DISTINCT FROM now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A measure or a reversal is added only in the transaction of its own decision.';
  END IF;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;

  -- 2.
  NEW.subject_account_id := NULL;
  NEW.post_id := NULL;
  NEW.reverses_action_id := NULL;
  NEW.no_effect := NULL;
  NEW.created_at := now();
  NEW.basis := NULL;
  NEW.rests_on := NULL;
  NEW.starts_at := NULL;
  NEW.ends_at := NULL;
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('suspend', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    NEW.days := NULL;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    NEW.announced := NULL;
  END IF;
  NEW.replaced := CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'lift_suspension' THEN coalesce(NEW.replaced, false) END;
  -- 3f: the withholding is forced below for a disable_by_order alone, and only a reinstatement names its ground.
  NEW.withhold_author := NULL;
  IF NEW.kind <> 'reinstate_by_order' THEN
    NEW.order_ground := NULL;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('seal_media', 'unseal_media') THEN
    NEW.media_id := NULL;
  END IF;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.author_id INTO subject FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    subject := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  IF subject IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The case''s target does not exist.';
  END IF;
  NEW.subject_account_id := subject;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'restore', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media', 'disable_by_order', 'reinstate_by_order') THEN
    NEW.post_id := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  is_measure := NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio',
                             'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting', 'disable_by_order');

  -- 3.
  IF (NEW.post_id IS NOT NULL AND c.target_type <> 'post')
     OR (NEW.kind IN ('reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'restore_display_name', 'restore_bio') AND c.target_type <> 'account') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'Post and image measures belong to a post case, field measures to an account case.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind IN ('strike', 'overrule') AND c.target_type <> 'post')
     OR (NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting', 'lift_suspension', 'unretire_handle', 'lift_reporting') AND c.target_type <> 'account') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A strike and its overruling belong to a post case, the account measures and their reversals to an account case.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (CASE d.kind
            WHEN 'interim' THEN NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media')
            WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media',
                                           'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting')
            -- 3f: an order decision holds disable_by_order and nothing else, and no other decision holds it.
            WHEN 'order' THEN NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order'
            ELSE NOT is_measure END) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision of this kind does not hold this measure or reversal.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An order decision holds exactly one disable_by_order.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'reinstate_by_order' AND (NEW.order_ground IS NULL OR d.kind <> 'correction') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A reinstatement after an order is a correction and names its ground.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'overrule' AND d.outcome <> 'reversed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A strike falls only with its whole finding: it is overruled only by a review or a correction that reverses the decision.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'retire_handle' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The retirement of a handle is its decision''s first measure.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND (NEW.days IS NULL OR NEW.announced IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND NEW.announced IS NULL)
     OR (NEW.kind = 'restrict_reporting' AND (NEW.days IS NULL OR NEW.announced IS DISTINCT FROM false)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A suspension names its days and whether it is announced, a termination whether it is announced, a restriction of reporting its days and that it is not announced.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind = 'seal_media'))
     OR (NEW.kind = 'seal_media' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate'))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision that seals holds no suspension or termination: each has a decision, a statement and an appeal of its own.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove') AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision holds at most one post measure.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media') THEN
    IF NEW.media_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id AND m.post_id = c.target_id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An image measure names an image of the case''s post.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.media_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'Only an image measure names an image.';
  END IF;

  -- 4.
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id FOR UPDATE;
  END IF;

  -- 5.
  IF d.kind = 'interim' AND NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'withhold_media') AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m
        WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.kind = NEW.kind AND m.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The case already holds this interim measure in force.';
  END IF;

  -- 6.
  IF NOT is_measure THEN
    lifted := CASE NEW.kind
                WHEN 'restore' THEN ARRAY['withhold', 'remove']
                WHEN 'unseal_media' THEN ARRAY['seal_media']
                WHEN 'restore_media' THEN ARRAY['withhold_media', 'remove_media']
                WHEN 'restore_display_name' THEN ARRAY['reset_display_name']
                WHEN 'overrule' THEN ARRAY['strike']
                WHEN 'lift_suspension' THEN ARRAY['suspend', 'terminate']
                WHEN 'unretire_handle' THEN ARRAY['retire_handle']
                WHEN 'lift_reporting' THEN ARRAY['warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting']
                WHEN 'reinstate_by_order' THEN ARRAY['disable_by_order']
                ELSE ARRAY['reset_bio'] END::public.action_kind[];
    IF d.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN
      SELECT a.id INTO target FROM public.decision_actions a
       WHERE a.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id AND a.kind = ANY(lifted) AND a.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id;
    ELSE
      SELECT m.id INTO target FROM public.measures_in_force m
       WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id
         AND m.kind = CASE NEW.kind WHEN 'restore' THEN 'withhold' ELSE 'withhold_media' END::public.action_kind;
    END IF;
    IF target IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = target) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A reversal lifts a measure that is in force.';
    END IF;
    NEW.reverses_action_id := target;
  END IF;

  -- 7.
  IF NEW.kind = 'seal_media' AND NOT (d.suspect AND (d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' OR d.category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A seal needs a decision that rests on a suspect item, under R2 or in the category Protection of minors.';
  END IF;

  -- 8. The subject's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record, so the lock order holds. 3f (row 13): an order about a
  -- staff member's post is given effect like any other.
  IF is_measure AND public.account_is_staff(subject) AND d.kind NOT IN ('interim', 'order') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_target';
  END IF;

  -- 9. The deciding account's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record; this reads the same row again.
  IF NEW.kind IN ('unseal_media', 'reinstate_by_order') THEN
    UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;
    SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = d.decided_by FOR SHARE;
    IF decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3f: a disable_by_order withholds from the author exactly when its order does (the order's row is held FOR SHARE
  -- since decisions_record), so signed params can never show a held notice's post to its author.
  IF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' THEN
    SELECT x.* INTO ord FROM public.legal_orders x JOIN public.legal_order_items i ON i.order_id = x.id WHERE i.id = d.order_item_id;
    NEW.withhold_author := ord.withhold_from_author;
  END IF;

  -- 9a. A standing measure.
  IF NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    -- 9a.1. Free when the API holds the row FOR UPDATE, as it does for these decisions.
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject FOR UPDATE;
    -- 9a.2. A statement of its own after the lock: one standing measure at a time, one with no start yet included.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.standing_live s WHERE s.account_id = subject) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing_conflict';
    END IF;
    -- 9a.3 and 9a.4. The basis: the first row of the table that fits the decision's own columns.
    IF d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' THEN
      -- A seal for good of the subject's images (a seal of a final decision about the account or one of its posts) in
      -- force, at most basis_age_days old, on which no protective suspension, standing or lifted, has rested yet.
      IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        SELECT m.decision_id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.decisions x ON x.id = m.decision_id
         WHERE m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'final' AND m.subject_account_id = subject
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND x.informed_at IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions p WHERE p.kind = 'suspend' AND p.basis = 'protective' AND m.decision_id = ANY(p.rests_on))
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'protective';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.protective_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        IF NEW.kind = 'terminate' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'ground_not_established';
        END IF;
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: under R2 only a protective suspension at once is open, on a seal for good no protective suspension rested on.';
      END IF;
    ELSIF d.ground IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' THEN
      IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced AND d.category_keyword IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT' THEN
        SELECT x.id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.id = x.case_id AND xc.target_type = 'post'
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.id = xc.target_id AND xp.author_id = subject
         WHERE x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.ground = 'illegal' AND x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND x.informed_at IS NOT NULL
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'terrorist';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.terrorist_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: on the law only a suspension at once on terrorist content is open, on a final decision that found it in a post of the account.';
      END IF;
    ELSE
      IF d.rule_id = 'R5' AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        SELECT x.id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.id = x.case_id AND xc.target_type = 'post'
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.id = xc.target_id AND xp.author_id = subject
         WHERE x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.rule_id = 'R5'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND x.informed_at IS NOT NULL
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'threat';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.threat_days;
        END IF;
      ELSIF d.rule_id = 'R5' AND NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        -- A suspension of the subject on the basis threat that stands, whose basis holds and that was decided within
        -- ladder_memory_days, and a final R5 decision as above about a post made after that suspension's decision was told.
        SELECT a.rests_on[1], x.id INTO earlier_decision, basis_decision
          FROM public.decision_actions a
          JOIN public.decisions ad ON ad.id = a.decision_id
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.author_id = subject AND xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
          JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.target_type = 'post' AND xc.target_id = xp.id
          JOIN public.decisions x ON x.case_id = xc.id
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind = 'suspend' AND a.basis = 'threat'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
           AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) IS NULL
           AND ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.ladder_memory_days)
           AND x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.rule_id = 'R5'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND x.informed_at IS NOT NULL
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC, ad.decided_at DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'threat_repeat';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[earlier_decision, basis_decision];
        END IF;
      ELSIF d.rule_id = 'R6' AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        -- The count is a floor under the admin's finding, which the decision's facts state, and never the finding.
        IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.posts p WHERE p.author_id = subject AND p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => rules.flood_minutes) AND p.import_job_id IS NULL) >= rules.flood_posts THEN
          NEW.basis := 'flood';
          max_days := rules.flood_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL AND NEW.announced THEN
        -- The ladder. The subject's active strikes, oldest first, and the rule of the newest.
        SELECT count(*), coalesce(array_agg(s.decision_id ORDER BY s.created_at, s.action_id), '{}'::uuid[]), max(s.created_at)
          INTO ladder_count, ladder_decisions, newest_strike_at
          FROM public.active_strikes s WHERE s.account_id = subject;
        SELECT x.rule_id INTO newest_rule
          FROM public.active_strikes s JOIN public.decisions x ON x.id = s.decision_id
         WHERE s.account_id = subject ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.action_id DESC LIMIT 1;
        SELECT max(a.created_at) INTO last_ladder_at FROM public.decision_actions a
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') AND a.basis IN ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id);
        SELECT count(*) INTO rungs_used FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions ad ON ad.id = a.decision_id
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind = 'suspend' AND a.basis = 'strikes'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
           AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) IS NULL
           AND ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.ladder_memory_days);
        ladder_holds := ladder_count >= rules.ladder_strikes
                        AND (last_ladder_at IS NULL OR newest_strike_at > last_ladder_at)
                        AND d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM newest_rule;
        IF ladder_holds AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' THEN
          NEW.basis := 'strikes';
          NEW.rests_on := ladder_decisions;
          max_days := rules.ladder_days[least(rungs_used + 1, cardinality(rules.ladder_days))];
        ELSIF ladder_holds AND NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND rungs_used >= cardinality(rules.ladder_days) THEN
          NEW.basis := 'ladder_end';
          NEW.rests_on := ladder_decisions;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: none fits. A measure at once needs its ground (R5 threat or second threat, R6 flood); an announced one the ladder.';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    -- 9a.5.
    IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NEW.days > max_days THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('days: at most %s on the basis %s.', max_days, NEW.basis);
    END IF;
    -- 9a.6.
    NEW.starts_at := CASE WHEN NEW.announced THEN now() + make_interval(hours => rules.reply_window_hours) ELSE now() END;
    -- 9a.7. The deciding account's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record; this reads the same row again.
    IF NOT NEW.announced OR NEW.kind = 'terminate' THEN
      UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;
      SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = d.decided_by FOR SHARE;
      IF decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    -- 9a.8. Findings only: such a measure judges nothing a report in this case named.
    IF NEW.basis IN ('strikes', 'protective', 'ladder_end') AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id WHERE i.answered_by = d.id AND n.kind = 'user') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'open_reports';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 9b. A strike.
  IF NEW.kind = 'strike' THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
    NEW.ends_at := now() + make_interval(days => rules.strike_days);
  END IF;

  -- 9c. A warning and a restriction of reporting (3e design, section 6.3). The counts are of reports (intakes): a report
  -- is marked when one of its items holds a mark that counts, which is a mark whose report was sent on a UTC day within
  -- report_frame_days, that no correction withdrew, and whose item no re-examination ended in a restriction. The view
  -- reporting_record is the reporting counts' migration's: PL/pgSQL resolves it only when this branch runs, which no
  -- route allows before that migration exists. The refusal open_reports comes first, before any count is read.
  IF NEW.kind IN ('warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    IF d.rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'R6' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A warning or a restriction of reporting cites R6.';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id WHERE i.answered_by = d.id AND n.kind = 'user') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'open_reports';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.kind = 'warn_reporting' THEN
      SELECT r.reports, r.unfounded INTO reports_sent, reports_marked FROM public.reporting_record r WHERE r.account_id = subject;
      IF coalesce(reports_marked, 0) < rules.report_warn_marks OR coalesce(reports_marked, 0) < rules.report_warn_share * coalesce(reports_sent, 0) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'warning: the account''s marked reports are below the threshold.';
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions w WHERE w.subject_account_id = subject AND w.kind = 'warn_reporting' AND w.ends_at > now()
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = w.id)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'warning: a warning of the account still counts.';
      END IF;
      NEW.basis := 'reports';
      NEW.ends_at := now() + make_interval(days => rules.report_frame_days);
    ELSE
      SELECT w.decision_id, wd.informed_at INTO warning_decision, warning_told
        FROM public.decision_actions w JOIN public.decisions wd ON wd.id = w.decision_id
       WHERE w.subject_account_id = subject AND w.kind = 'warn_reporting' AND w.ends_at > now()
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = w.id)
       ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1;
      IF warning_decision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: the account has no warning that still counts.';
      END IF;
      -- Reports the person sent after korbat told them of the warning, never reports sent before it and decided after.
      SELECT count(DISTINCT m.intake_id) INTO reports_marked
        FROM public.unfounded_marks m
       WHERE m.account_id = subject AND m.reported_at > warning_told AND m.withdrawn_by IS NULL
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items o WHERE o.id = m.item_id AND o.outcome_sent_at IS NOT NULL)
         AND (m.reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - rules.report_frame_days
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items x WHERE x.reexamines_item_id = m.item_id AND x.outcome IN ('restricted_rule', 'restricted_legal'));
      IF reports_marked < rules.report_restrict_marks THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: too few marked reports sent since the warning.';
      END IF;
      IF NEW.days > rules.report_restrict_days THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('days: at most %s for a restriction of reporting.', rules.report_restrict_days);
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.subject_account_id = subject AND x.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = x.id)
                    AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(x.id) IS NULL AND x.starts_at + make_interval(days => x.days) > now()) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: a restriction of the account''s reports still runs.';
      END IF;
      NEW.basis := 'reports';
      NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[warning_decision];
      NEW.starts_at := now();
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 10.
  IF is_measure AND NEW.kind NOT IN ('seal_media', 'strike') THEN
    IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      SELECT p.state, p.moderation_level INTO post_state, post_level FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
      IF post_state = 'deleted_by_author' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'deleted';
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'withhold' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level <> 'visible' THEN 'already' END;
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'remove' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level IN ('removed', 'disabled') THEN 'already' END;
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level = 'disabled' OR (post_level = 'removed' AND NOT NEW.withhold_author) THEN 'already' END;
      ELSE
        SELECT m.moderation_state INTO image_state FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id;
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level <> 'visible'
                                OR (NEW.kind = 'withhold_media' AND image_state <> 'visible')
                                OR (NEW.kind = 'remove_media' AND image_state IN ('removed', 'sealed')) THEN 'already' END;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      SELECT p.* INTO profile FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject;
      IF profile.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'deleted';
      ELSIF (NEW.kind = 'reset_display_name' AND profile.display_name = profile.handle) OR (NEW.kind = 'reset_bio' AND profile.bio = '') THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'already';
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'retire_handle' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.evidence_snapshots s JOIN public.handle_history h ON h.handle_lower = lower(s.handle)
               WHERE s.id = d.snapshot_id AND h.retired_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'already';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 11.
  IF target IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT x.* INTO target_decision FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.decision_id = x.id WHERE a.id = target;
    IF target_decision.kind = 'interim' AND target_decision.author_mail <> 'none' THEN
      -- 3f: a statement of its own; on a post whose order's notice is held the telling this makes owed is held too.
      held := c.target_type = 'post' AND public.order_notice_held(c.target_id);
      UPDATE public.decisions x
         SET ended_interim = true,
             author_mail = CASE WHEN x.author_mail = 'none' AND NOT held THEN 'pending'::public.delivery_state ELSE x.author_mail END,
             informed_at = CASE WHEN x.author_mail = 'none' AND held THEN NULL ELSE x.informed_at END
       WHERE x.id = d.id;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
```

### Create `packages/db/migrations/0045_import_readers.sql`

```sql
-- 3b (design, sections 6.2 and 6.7; Task 2): the readers' indexes, written by drizzle from the schema and kept apart
-- from 0044 so that their builds over a large posts table run in a migration of their own (the README's upgrade notes
-- name it as the slow one). posts_imported_idx serves the profile's Imported tab; posts_author_native_idx the author's
-- native posts (Following's own branch, the Posts and Replies tabs); posts_latest_idx is dropped and created again with
-- `and import_job_id is null` added to its predicate, so Latest never reads an imported post. Nothing here is written by
-- hand but this comment.
DROP INDEX "posts_latest_idx";--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX "posts_imported_idx" ON "posts" USING btree ("author_id","original_created_at","id") WHERE import_job_id is not null and reply_to_id is null;--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX "posts_author_native_idx" ON "posts" USING btree ("author_id","created_at","id") WHERE import_job_id is null;--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX "posts_latest_idx" ON "posts" USING btree ("created_at","id") WHERE reply_to_id is null and state = 'visible' and import_job_id is null;
```

```json
          "name": "decisions_api_all",

          "for": "ALL",

            "korbat_api"
          ],
          "using": "true",
          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

          "value": "\"legal_order_events\".\"kind\" in ('opened', 'annex3_sent', 'grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received', 'annex2_sent', 'receipt_confirmed', 'closed_without_effect', 'reopened', 'hold_extended', 'corrected', 'effect_given', 'reinstated', 'notice_released', 'preservation_ended', 'verified', 'issued_at_set', 'texts_recorded', 'document_recorded', 'received_set', 'sent_at_set', 'due_set', 'hold_ended', 'hold_until_set', 'preservation_extended', 'scrutiny_requested', 'scrutiny_decided', 'tell_person_set', 'person_told', 'imported')"
        },

          "value": "(kind = 'annex3_sent' and ground in ('force_majeure', 'manifest_error', 'insufficient_information')) or (kind = 'closed_without_effect' and ground in ('withdrawn', 'annulled', 'scrutiny', 'not_authentic', 'wrong_item', 'not_addressed')) or (kind = 'corrected' and ground in ('entry', 'caution', 'admin')) or (kind = 'reinstated' and ground in ('withdrawn', 'annulled', 'scrutiny', 'not_authentic', 'wrong_item')) or (kind = 'hold_ended' and ground in ('not_authentic', 'annulled', 'released_by_authority', 'not_ordered')) or (kind = 'scrutiny_decided' and ground in ('upheld', 'annulled')) or (kind = 'texts_recorded' and ground in ('reasons', 'redress', 'scope')) or (kind not in ('annex3_sent', 'closed_without_effect', 'corrected', 'reinstated', 'hold_ended', 'scrutiny_decided') and ground is null)"
        },
```

```json
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

          "value": "\"intake_items\".\"shown_outcome\" is null or \"intake_items\".\"outcome_sent_at\" is not null"
        },
        "intake_items_named_handle": {
          "name": "intake_items_named_handle",
          "value": "(\"intake_items\".\"target_type\" = 'account') = (\"intake_items\".\"named_handle\" is not null)"
        },

        }
      },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },

        },

        }

        "legal_orders_kind": {
          "name": "legal_orders_kind",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" in ('tco_removal', 'dsa_art9', 'dsa_art10')"
        },
        "legal_orders_member_state": {
          "name": "legal_orders_member_state",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"member_state\" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'"
        },
        "legal_orders_names": {
          "name": "legal_orders_names",
          "value": "char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"authority\") between 1 and 200 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"reference\") between 1 and 200"
        },
        "legal_orders_channel": {
          "name": "legal_orders_channel",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"channel\" in ('mailbox', 'portal', 'post', 'other')"
        },
        "legal_orders_opened_via": {
          "name": "legal_orders_opened_via",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"opened_via\" in ('console', 'cli')"
        },
        "legal_orders_received": {
          "name": "legal_orders_received",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\" and \"legal_orders\".\"sent_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\""
        },
        "legal_orders_issued": {
          "name": "legal_orders_issued",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"issued_at\" <= coalesce(\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\", \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\")"
        },
        "legal_orders_tco": {
          "name": "legal_orders_tco",
          "value": "((\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' and not \"legal_orders\".\"section_c\") or \"legal_orders\".\"withhold_from_author\") and (\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' or \"legal_orders\".\"preserve\")"
        },
        "legal_orders_tell": {
          "name": "legal_orders_tell",
          "value": "(\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" is null or (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" in ('at_effect', 'at_instant', 'never') and \"legal_orders\".\"kind\" = 'dsa_art10')) and (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person_at\" is not null) = (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" is not distinct from 'at_instant')"
        },
        "legal_orders_hold_end": {
          "name": "legal_orders_hold_end",
          "value": "(\"legal_orders\".\"hold_ended_at\" is null) = (\"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" is null) and \"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" in ('not_authentic', 'annulled', 'released_by_authority', 'not_ordered')"
        },
        "legal_orders_texts_len": {
          "name": "legal_orders_texts_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"verified_how\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"hold_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"scope\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"reasons\") <= 4000 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"redress\") <= 4000"
        },
        "legal_orders_document": {
          "name": "legal_orders_document",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"document_sha256\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and \"legal_orders\".\"document_bytes\" >= 0"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        "authority_notifications_state": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_state",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" in ('owed', 'sent', 'declined')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_duties": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_duties",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\" <@ array['dsa18_1', 'dsa18_2', 'tco14_5', 'voluntary']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent_kinds": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent_kinds",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" <@ array['handle', 'address', 'created_at', 'post_ids', 'post_times', 'report_time', 'files']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answer": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answer",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" in ('not_illegal', 'illegal', 'no_assessment', 'other')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_opened_via": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_opened_via",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" in ('system', 'cli')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_seal": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_seal",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" = 'system') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"seal_action_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_closed": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_closed",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'owed') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"closed_at\" is null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_declined": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_declined",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'declined') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" <> 'sent' or (\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_at\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"authority\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"channel\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" is not null and cardinality(\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\") > 0 and \"authority_notifications\".\"not_kept_version\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answered": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answered",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" is null or \"authority_notifications\".\"answered_at\" is not null"
        },
        "authority_notifications_texts": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_texts",
          "value": "char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"check_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"state_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"checked_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"authority\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"channel\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"receipt\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"own_reference\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"their_reference\") <= 200"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },
```

```json
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        }
```
