```json
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "authority_notifications_state": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_state",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" in ('owed', 'sent', 'declined')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_duties": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_duties",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\" <@ array['dsa18_1', 'dsa18_2', 'tco14_5', 'voluntary']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent_kinds": {

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" <@ array['handle', 'address', 'created_at', 'post_ids', 'post_times', 'report_time', 'files']::text[]"

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" in ('not_illegal', 'illegal', 'no_assessment', 'other')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_opened_via": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_opened_via",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" in ('system', 'cli')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_seal": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_seal",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" = 'system') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"seal_action_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_closed": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_closed",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'owed') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"closed_at\" is null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_declined": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_declined",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'declined') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" <> 'sent' or (\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_at\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"authority\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"channel\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" is not null and cardinality(\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\") > 0 and \"authority_notifications\".\"not_kept_version\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answered": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answered",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" is null or \"authority_notifications\".\"answered_at\" is not null"
        },
        "authority_notifications_texts": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_texts",
          "value": "char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"check_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"state_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"checked_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"authority\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"channel\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"receipt\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"own_reference\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"their_reference\") <= 200"
        }

    },
```

### Create `packages/db/src/schema/imports.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { bigint, boolean, check, date, index, integer, jsonb, pgEnum, pgTable, primaryKey, text, uniqueIndex, uuid } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, bytea, fullAccess, ts } from "./helpers";
import { profiles } from "./identity";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- import from other platforms (3b design, sections 6.1, 6.4 and 6.7; Task 2)
// The three tables of the migration imports. Only the API's imports module names them. The closed lists and numbers are
// the contracts' (packages/contracts/src/imports.ts: IMPORT_SOURCE_KINDS, ImportStatus, IMPORT_ACTIVE_STATES,
// IMPORT_FAILURES, IMPORT_STOP_REASONS and IMPORT_RULES), written out here because this package does not depend on the
// contracts; apps/api/test/integration/import-schema.test.ts holds every migrated CHECK, enum and predicate equal to them.
// The migration's hand-written part adds the triggers that force an insert's columns, walk the states of section 4.1 and
// guard the deletes, and the API role's grants.

/** Where an archive came from. A later source is one more value (section 1.4). */
export const importSource = pgEnum("import_source", ["x", "mastodon", "bluesky"]);

/** The twelve states of section 4.1, in ImportStatus's order. The first five are active. */
export const importStatus = pgEnum("import_status", ["uploading", "scanning", "ready", "preparing", "publishing", "done", "stopped", "undoing", "undone", "failed", "cancelled", "expired"]);

/**
 * One import (6.1): an archive's upload, its scan, the person's choice and the publishing, as one row moving through the
 * twelve states. It holds the source, the state, the times, the choice and counts only: never a file name, a handle or a
 * text, but the first words of a post whose image was refused, shown to the person alone (decision 25). import_jobs_insert
 * forces every column but the id, the owner, the source and the size; import_jobs_guard lets each later column change
 * only by the move that names it. A post names its import (posts.import_job_id), so the row stays while one does.
 */
export const importJobs = pgTable(
  "import_jobs",
  {
    /** Made by the API (randomUUID): it names the import's folders on the two volumes. */
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey(),
    /** No on delete clause: no profile row is ever deleted. */
    ownerId: uuid("owner_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => profiles.id),
    source: importSource("source").notNull(),
    /** Forced to uploading at insert. */
    status: importStatus("status").notNull().default("uploading"),
    /** The archive's size as the person's app declared it: 1 byte to IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes. */
    declaredBytes: bigint("declared_bytes", { mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    /** Bytes stored so far; only grows, never past the declared size. */
    receivedBytes: bigint("received_bytes", { mode: "number" }).notNull().default(0),
    /** Forced to clock_timestamp() at insert. */
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Each set once, by the move that names it: into scanning, out of scanning, out of ready by a confirmation. */
    uploadedAt: ts("uploaded_at"),
    scannedAt: ts("scanned_at"),
    confirmedAt: ts("confirmed_at"),
    /** Set by the move into done, stopped, failed, cancelled or expired, and again by the move into undone. */
    endedAt: ts("ended_at"),
    /** IMPORT_FAILURES; set exactly when the state is failed. */
    failure: text("failure"),
    /** IMPORT_STOP_REASONS; set by the move into stopped, and kept through undoing and undone. */
    stopReason: text("stop_reason"),
    /** An admin's end of the whole import (8.7): when, and under which rule. Set together, once. */
    staffEndedAt: ts("staff_ended_at"),
    staffRuleId: text("staff_rule_id"),
    /** The archive's day and first words of the post whose image was refused (8.2). Set together, once. */
    refusedAtOriginal: date("refused_at_original"),
    refusedWords: text("refused_words"),
    /** The intake's numbers (ImportScanFacts); never a text. Set by the move into ready, and cut down by the move out of it. */
    scan: jsonb("scan"),
    /** ImportChoice, the person's statement and the seed come with the confirmation, together and once. */
    choice: jsonb("choice"),
    statedAt: ts("stated_at"),
    /** 32 random bytes from which the import's post and image ids are derived (6.5); cleared when the import ends. */
    seed: bytea("seed"),
    /** Lines of posts.jsonl handled, and images handed to the feeder; each only grows. */
    postCursor: integer("post_cursor").notNull().default(0),
    imageCursor: integer("image_cursor").notNull().default(0),
    /** Progress counts; each only grows. */
    postsPublished: integer("posts_published").notNull().default(0),
    imagesKept: integer("images_kept").notNull().default(0),
    imagesLeftOut: integer("images_left_out").notNull().default(0),
    postsRemoved: integer("posts_removed").notNull().default(0),
  },
  (t) => [
    // IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes.
    check("import_jobs_declared_bytes", sql`${t.declaredBytes} between 1 and 2147483648`),
    check("import_jobs_received_bytes", sql`${t.receivedBytes} between 0 and ${t.declaredBytes}`),
    // IMPORT_FAILURES.
    check(
      "import_jobs_failure",
      sql`${t.failure} in ('not_this_source', 'not_an_archive', 'tar_gz', 'partial_archive', 'encrypted', 'too_many_entries', 'too_large_uncompressed', 'bad_entry_name', 'unreadable', 'nothing_to_import', 'scan_timed_out', 'interrupted')`,
    ),
    // The state is compared as text, as 3b compares every enum (section 6).
    check("import_jobs_failed", sql`(${t.status}::text = 'failed') = (${t.failure} is not null)`),
    // IMPORT_STOP_REASONS.
    check("import_jobs_stop_reason", sql`${t.stopReason} in ('refused_image', 'by_author', 'by_staff', 'time_ran_out')`),
    // A stopped import has its reason; the reason stays through the undo, and no other state has one.
    check("import_jobs_stopped", sql`(${t.status}::text <> 'stopped' or ${t.stopReason} is not null) and (${t.stopReason} is null or ${t.status}::text in ('stopped', 'undoing', 'undone'))`),
    check("import_jobs_staff", sql`(${t.staffEndedAt} is null) = (${t.staffRuleId} is null)`),
    check("import_jobs_refused", sql`(${t.refusedAtOriginal} is null) = (${t.refusedWords} is null)`),
    // IMPORT_RULES.refusedWordsMax, in code points.
    check("import_jobs_refused_words", sql`char_length(${t.refusedWords}) <= 80`),
    // IMPORT_RULES.scanMaxBytes and choiceMaxBytes, as the bytes of the jsonb's text form.
    check("import_jobs_scan", sql`jsonb_typeof(${t.scan}) = 'object' and octet_length(${t.scan}::text) <= 262144`),
    check("import_jobs_choice", sql`jsonb_typeof(${t.choice}) = 'object' and octet_length(${t.choice}::text) <= 1024`),
    // The statement is never stored without the choice it confirmed, nor the choice without it.
    check("import_jobs_stated", sql`(${t.choice} is null) = (${t.statedAt} is null)`),
    // IMPORT_RULES.seedBytes.
    check("import_jobs_seed", sql`octet_length(${t.seed}) = 32`),
    check(
      "import_jobs_counts",
      sql`${t.postCursor} >= 0 and ${t.imageCursor} >= 0 and ${t.postsPublished} >= 0 and ${t.imagesKept} >= 0 and ${t.imagesLeftOut} >= 0 and ${t.postsRemoved} >= 0`,
    ),
    /**
     * One active import an account (4.1): the five states of IMPORT_ACTIVE_STATES. The enum's labels are literals here, not
     * text: an index predicate takes only immutable expressions, and the cast of an enum to text is not one. The type is
     * created in the same migration, so its labels are usable at once.
     */
    uniqueIndex("import_jobs_one_active").on(t.ownerId).where(sql`status in ('uploading', 'scanning', 'ready', 'preparing', 'publishing')`),
    /** import-drive's rounds, by state and age. */
    index("import_jobs_status_idx").on(t.status, t.createdAt),
    /** The account's list of its imports, and the purge's. */
    index("import_jobs_owner_idx").on(t.ownerId, t.createdAt),
    fullAccess("import_jobs_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The person's choices post by post (4.4): a line of posts.jsonl left out, and a description for each of its images the
 * source gave none, by position. Written only while the import is ready (import_picks_guard); deleted when the import
 * ends, and with the import's row in any case.
 */
export const importPicks = pgTable(
  "import_picks",
  {
    importJobId: uuid("import_job_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => importJobs.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    /** The line's ref, its place in posts.jsonl. */
    ref: integer("ref").notNull(),
    leftOut: boolean("left_out").notNull().default(false),
    /** An array of at most MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST AltText or null, or null. */
    alts: jsonb("alts"),
  },
  (t) => [
    primaryKey({ columns: [t.importJobId, t.ref] }),
    // At most four descriptions (MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST) in IMPORT_RULES.altsMaxBytes, as the bytes of the jsonb's text form:
    // four AltText of 1,000 code points take up to 16,016 (Task 1's amendment). A CASE, so the length is read only of an array.
    check(
      "import_picks_alts",
      sql`case jsonb_typeof(${t.alts}) when 'array' then jsonb_array_length(${t.alts}) <= 4 and octet_length(${t.alts}::text) <= 16384 else ${t.alts} is null end`,
    ),
    fullAccess("import_picks_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * Each importing account's random key of section 5.4, under which the importer hashes every source post's id, so a later
 * import skips what an earlier one published (decision 24) and two accounts' imports are never linked. Inserted at the
 * account's first import; never updated (the API role holds no UPDATE); deleted only once the profile is (the purge).
 */
export const importKeys = pgTable(
  "import_keys",
  {
    /** No on delete clause: no profile row is ever deleted. */
    ownerId: uuid("owner_id")
      .primaryKey()
      .references(() => profiles.id),
    key: bytea("key").notNull(),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    // IMPORT_RULES.keyBytes.
    check("import_keys_key", sql`octet_length(${t.key}) = 32`),
    fullAccess("import_keys_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { bigint, boolean, check, index, integer, pgEnum, pgTable, primaryKey, real, smallint, text, uniqueIndex, uuid, type AnyPgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, bytea, fullAccess, ts } from "./helpers";
import { profiles } from "./identity";
import { importJobs, importSource } from "./imports";

/** 3f (design, section 6.2): `disabled`, a post an authority's order disables, which every reader answers as missing. */
export const postState = pgEnum("post_state", ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "deleted_by_author", "disabled"]);

/**
 * What moderation derives for a post from the measures in force (3c design, section 6.1): the strongest of them.
 * posts.state mirrors it unless the author deleted the post, so post_state gains no value of 3c's. 3f adds `disabled`
 * to both (design, section 6.2), above `removed`: no row holds it before an order is given effect.
 */
export const moderationLevel = pgEnum("moderation_level", ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "disabled"]);

/** An image's own moderation state, beside its post's. Only an image is ever sealed: shown to nobody, its author included. */
export const mediaModerationState = pgEnum("media_moderation_state", ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "sealed"]);

/** A counter kept exact by the application: updated in the same transaction as the action it counts. */
const counter = (name: string) => integer(name).notNull().default(0);

export const posts = pgTable(
  "posts",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    authorId: uuid("author_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    body: text("body").notNull(),
    replyToId: uuid("reply_to_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => posts.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    quoteOfId: uuid("quote_of_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => posts.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    state: postState("state").notNull().default("visible"),
    likeCount: counter("like_count"),
    repostCount: counter("repost_count"),
    /** Replies that are not deleted. */
    replyCount: counter("reply_count"),
    /** Quotes that are not deleted. */
    quoteCount: counter("quote_count"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Set together with state = 'deleted_by_author'; the body is blanked at the same time. */
    deletedAt: ts("deleted_at"),
    /** Derived from the ledger of measures by a migrator-owned function, the only writer; the API role cannot update it. */
    moderationLevel: moderationLevel("moderation_level").notNull().default("visible"),
    /** Set, one way, when the R4 redaction erased the post's content; written only by a migrator-owned function. */
    erasedAt: ts("erased_at"),
    /**
     * Explore's resume rule (3e design, sections 6.1 and 6.4): when the post last left the level visible, when it last came
     * back, and the time its age and window are counted from after its hidden spans. Outside the API's column grants; a
     * later migration gives them their one writer, moderation_apply.
     */
    hiddenAt: ts("hidden_at"),
    restoredAt: ts("restored_at"),
    exploreFrom: ts("explore_from"),
    /**
     * 3b (design, section 6.2): an imported post's import, source, the date its archive gives it, whether it was cut to
     * 1,000 characters, and the key of section 5.4 (32 bytes) by which a later import of the account skips it. All five
     * are set or none is (a native post, or an imported one's tombstone); posts_import_guard (migration 0044) lets an
     * insert set them only for a publishing import of the author with the same source, and an update only clear them, all
     * at once, with the post's tombstone. No on delete clause on the job: its row cannot go while a post names it.
     */
    importJobId: uuid("import_job_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => importJobs.id),
    importSource: importSource("import_source"),
    originalCreatedAt: ts("original_created_at"),
    importShortened: boolean("import_shortened"),
    importKey: bytea("import_key"),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("posts_author_created_idx").on(t.authorId, t.createdAt),
    /** Explore's restored posts. */
    index("posts_explore_from_idx").on(t.exploreFrom).where(sql`explore_from is not null`),
    index("posts_created_id_idx").on(t.createdAt, t.id),
    /** A thread's replies in order, and every lookup by parent. */
    index("posts_reply_to_created_idx").on(t.replyToId, t.createdAt, t.id),
    /**
     * The public Latest timeline: visible top-level posts and quotes, newest first. 3b (6.2): imported posts are in no
     * feed, so the predicate leaves them out (migration 0045 drops the index and creates it again).
     */
    index("posts_latest_idx").on(t.createdAt, t.id).where(sql`reply_to_id is null and state = 'visible' and import_job_id is null`),
    index("posts_quote_of_idx").on(t.quoteOfId),
    /** 3b: a post is imported once per account while it exists (decision 24). */
    uniqueIndex("posts_import_key_idx").on(t.authorId, t.importKey).where(sql`import_key is not null`),
    /** 3b: an import's posts, for the undo, the foreign key's checks and the job's count. */
    index("posts_import_job_idx").on(t.importJobId, t.id).where(sql`import_job_id is not null`),
    /** 3b (0045): the profile's Imported tab, its top-level imported posts by the archive's date. */
    index("posts_imported_idx").on(t.authorId, t.originalCreatedAt, t.id).where(sql`import_job_id is not null and reply_to_id is null`),
    /**
     * 3b (0045): an author's native posts, for Following's own branch and the Posts and Replies tabs, so a followed
     * account's 50,000 imported posts are never scanned there.
     */
    index("posts_author_native_idx").on(t.authorId, t.createdAt, t.id).where(sql`import_job_id is null`),
    check("posts_body_len", sql`char_length(${t.body}) <= 1000`),
    check("posts_counts_nonnegative", sql`${t.likeCount} >= 0 and ${t.repostCount} >= 0 and ${t.replyCount} >= 0 and ${t.quoteCount} >= 0`),
    check(
      "posts_import_columns",
      sql`(${t.importJobId} is null) = (${t.importSource} is null) and (${t.importJobId} is null) = (${t.originalCreatedAt} is null) and (${t.importJobId} is null) = (${t.importShortened} is null) and (${t.importJobId} is null) = (${t.importKey} is null)`,
    ),
    fullAccess("posts_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * One Explore ranking (a "generation"), written by the refresh job (2c design, sections 6 and 7). The current ranking
 * is the highest generation; the job also keeps the one before it, so a reader paging through a ranking is not cut
 * off by the next round.
 */
export const exploreRuns = pgTable(
  "explore_runs",
  {
    /** Numbered by the database. One ranking every 5 minutes lasts 20,000 years in an integer. */
    generation: integer("generation").primaryKey().generatedAlwaysAsIdentity(),
    /** The refresh time the round was given; the ranking is computed as of this time. */
    asOf: ts("as_of").notNull(),
    /** The version of the formula the round ranked with (EXPLORE_V2.version in @korbat/contracts; rankings from before 3e hold 1). */
    formula: smallint("formula").notNull(),
    /** Posts that passed the candidate predicate at as_of. */
    candidates: integer("candidates").notNull(),
    /** Posts the ranking holds; their positions run from 1 to this. */
    items: integer("items").notNull(),
    /** How long the round took. */
    tookMs: integer("took_ms").notNull(),
  },
  () => [fullAccess("explore_runs_api_all", apiRole)],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The posts of one Explore ranking, in order. No score or count is stored: nothing reads them after the insert, and
 * the position is the order. A row goes with its ranking, its post or its author.
 */
export const exploreItems = pgTable(
  "explore_items",
  {
    generation: integer("generation").notNull().references(() => exploreRuns.generation, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    /** 1 to the ranking's item count, without gaps. */
    position: integer("position").notNull(),
    postId: uuid("post_id").notNull().references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    /** The post's author, so an author's places in a ranking are counted without reading the posts. */
    authorId: uuid("author_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  },
  (t) => [
    primaryKey({ columns: [t.generation, t.position] }),
    /** A post has one place in a ranking. */
    uniqueIndex("explore_items_generation_post_idx").on(t.generation, t.postId),
    fullAccess("explore_items_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/** An upload is processing until the worker's result is in, then ready or failed for good. */
export const mediaStatus = pgEnum("media_status", ["processing", "ready", "failed"]);

/**
 * One uploaded image. The files live on the media-store volume under the row's id; no path is
 * stored. Only the API's media module reads or writes this table.
 */
export const postMedia = pgTable(
  "post_media",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    /** Who uploaded it. Only this account may attach it to a post. */
    ownerId: uuid("owner_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    status: mediaStatus("status").notNull().default("processing"),
    /** Why processing failed: one of the contracts' MediaFailure values. */
    error: text("error"),
    /** Set, together with the position, when the image is attached to a post. */
    postId: uuid("post_id").references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    position: integer("position"),
    /** Of the large size, after rotation. Set, together with the blurhash, when processing succeeds. */
    width: integer("width"),
    height: integer("height"),
    blurhash: text("blurhash"),
    altText: text("alt_text"),
    /** Filled by sub-project 3. Empty until then. */
    nsfwScore: real("nsfw_score"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    // The three columns below are forced to their defaults at insert and written only by migrator-owned functions; the
    // API role holds no UPDATE on them (migration 0015).
    /** Derived from the ledger of measures, as the post's level is. */
    moderationState: mediaModerationState("moderation_state").notNull().default("visible"),
    /** The latest end of the image's unreleased holds (media_holds): while it lies ahead, every delete skips the row. */
    holdUntil: ts("hold_until"),
    /** Set when an R4 removal of the image became final and its content was erased. */
    erasedAt: ts("erased_at"),
    /**
     * 3b (design, section 6.3): the image came from an import, which never changes; and the running import that owns the
     * upload, so the sweeper leaves it alone and the import cleans it up. post_media_import_insert (migration 0044) takes an
     * imported row only for a preparing import of its owner and a native one naming no import; the API role holds no
     * UPDATE of either. The import's row may go first: then its id is set null and the row stays imported, which
     * post_media_import_attach lets onto no post.
     */
    imported: boolean("imported").notNull().default(false),
    importJobId: uuid("import_job_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => importJobs.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("post_media_post_position_idx").on(t.postId, t.position),
    index("post_media_owner_created_idx").on(t.ownerId, t.createdAt),
    index("post_media_status_created_idx").on(t.status, t.createdAt),
    check("post_media_ready_has_dims", sql`${t.status} <> 'ready' or (${t.width} is not null and ${t.height} is not null and ${t.blurhash} is not null)`),
    check("post_media_attached_is_complete", sql`${t.postId} is null or (${t.status} = 'ready' and ${t.position} between 0 and 3 and ${t.altText} is not null)`),
    check("post_media_alt_len", sql`char_length(${t.altText}) <= 1000`),
    check("post_media_import_link", sql`${t.importJobId} is null or ${t.imported}`),
    /**
     * 3b: an import's images by their job. The foreign key's set null when a job row goes, and the import's cleanup of its
     * unattached rows in id order (media.deleteImportLeftovers), would scan post_media without it.
     */
    index("post_media_import_job_idx").on(t.importJobId, t.id).where(sql`import_job_id is not null`),
    fullAccess("post_media_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The edge's outbox (3d design, sections 2 row 11, 6.3 and 7.4; Task 3): one row each time an image stops being public,
 * which the job edge-purge drains to the purge adapter. No role inserts a row: the two definer triggers post_media_purge
 * and posts_purge write it in the transaction that hides the image, whoever the writer is, and the API's role holds no
 * INSERT, so no route can forget one and none can invent one. The insert trigger edge_purges_insert forces `created_at`
 * (clock_timestamp()) and `next_at` (now(): due at once). The API's job reads it, moves the four columns of a purge's
 * progress and (Task 8) deletes a row 30 days after it was done. No foreign key: an image's row may go, by a deletion or
 * the disposal, while its purge is still owed. The closed lists are the contracts' EDGE_PURGE_CAUSES and
 * EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES, written out here; a database test holds each migrated CHECK to its constant.
 */
export const edgePurges = pgTable(
  "edge_purges",
  {
    id: bigint("id", { mode: "number" }).primaryKey().generatedAlwaysAsIdentity(),
    mediaId: uuid("media_id").notNull(),
    /** state, deleted or released. */
    cause: text("cause").notNull(),
    /** Forced: clock_timestamp(). */
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull(),
    /** Forced at insert: now(). The job moves it back off after a failed purge. */
    nextAt: ts("next_at").notNull(),
    attempts: smallint("attempts").notNull().default(0),
    /** accepted, failed or off; set with done_at, once. */
    outcome: text("outcome"),
    doneAt: ts("done_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("edge_purges_cause", sql`${t.cause} in ('state', 'deleted', 'released')`),
    check("edge_purges_outcome", sql`${t.outcome} in ('accepted', 'failed', 'off')`),
    check("edge_purges_done", sql`(${t.outcome} is null) = (${t.doneAt} is null)`),
    check("edge_purges_attempts", sql`${t.attempts} >= 0`),
    /** The job's round: the rows still owed a purge, by when they are due. */
    index("edge_purges_due_idx").on(t.nextAt).where(sql`done_at is null`),
    /** The case's and the order's purge line: the newest row of an image. */
    index("edge_purges_media_idx").on(t.mediaId, t.id),
    fullAccess("edge_purges_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/** user -> user relation table (follows, blocks, mutes). */
function userPairTable(name: string, from: string, to: string) {
  return pgTable(
    name,
    {
      fromId: uuid(from).notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      toId: uuid(to).notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    },
    (t) => [
      primaryKey({ columns: [t.fromId, t.toId] }),
      /** Pages of either side, newest first, and every lookup by either side. */
      index(`${name}_to_created_idx`).on(t.toId, t.createdAt, t.fromId),
      index(`${name}_from_created_idx`).on(t.fromId, t.createdAt, t.toId),
      check(`${name}_not_self`, sql`${t.fromId} <> ${t.toId}`),
      fullAccess(`${name}_api_all`, apiRole),
    ],
  ).enableRLS();
}

/**
 * user -> post relation table (likes, reposts, bookmarks). `createdBrin` adds `<name>_created_brin`, a BRIN index on
 * created_at, for the tables whose recent rows the Explore refresh reads (2c design, section 6).
 */
function userPostTable(name: string, options: { createdBrin?: boolean } = {}) {
  return pgTable(
    name,
    {
      userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      postId: uuid("post_id").notNull().references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    },
    (t) => [
      primaryKey({ columns: [t.userId, t.postId] }),
      index(`${name}_post_idx`).on(t.postId),
      /** Per-account lists (your likes, your bookmarks) and the reposts half of the Following timeline. */
      index(`${name}_user_created_idx`).on(t.userId, t.createdAt),
      // Rows arrive roughly in time order, so a BRIN index of a few kilobytes finds the refresh's window as fast as a
      // btree of many megabytes. Unlikes, blocks and purges let later rows fill old pages and erode that order slowly.
      ...(options.createdBrin ? [index(`${name}_created_brin`).using("brin", t.createdAt)] : []),
      fullAccess(`${name}_api_all`, apiRole),
    ],
  ).enableRLS();
}

export const follows = userPairTable("follows", "follower_id", "followee_id");
export const blocks = userPairTable("blocks", "blocker_id", "blocked_id");
export const mutes = userPairTable("mutes", "muter_id", "muted_id");
export const likes = userPostTable("likes", { createdBrin: true });
export const reposts = userPostTable("reposts", { createdBrin: true });
/** Bookmarks are private and never count towards Explore, so they need no index by time. */
export const bookmarks = userPostTable("bookmarks");
```
